user.title: Boon Smart Home Authentication
user.description:
Enter your phone number registered in Boon (e.g., +374XXXXXXXX).

💡 **Mobile App Session Note**: Boon may invalidate existing active mobile sessions when a new login occurs with the same phone number. If you actively use the Boon mobile app, consider using a secondary phone number invited to your apartment in Boon to keep both active simultaneously.

You can also optionally register additional camera URLs (e.g. from other accounts or shared intercom links).

data.custom_cameras: Additional Camera URLs (optional, one per line)

otp.title: Verify SMS Code
otp.description: Enter the 5 or 6 digit verification code sent via SMS to {phone_number}.
